_help: Quiz for Rug or Real: Read the Token Split. 5 to 8 questions. answer must match one of the options exactly. explain is shown after the quiz. This folder is never shown to visitors.

questions.question: What is a token split (tokenomics)?
options: Who gets the tokens, and when they can sell
questions.answer: Who gets the tokens, and when they can sell
questions.explain: Tokenomics shows how the supply is shared between the team, investors and the community.

questions.question: The team holds 60% of the supply with no lock. What does that suggest?
options: A big red flag: they could sell at any time
A sign of a fair launch
questions.answer: A big red flag: they could sell at any time
questions.explain: Large, unlocked insider holdings are a classic rug risk.

questions.question: What does vesting mean?
options: Tokens unlock bit by bit over time instead of all at once
Tokens are given away for free
Tokens are moved to an exchange
questions.answer: Tokens unlock bit by bit over time instead of all at once
questions.explain: Vesting stops insiders from selling everything on day one.

questions.question: Why can a big unlock date move the price?
options: Many tokens can be sold at once
questions.answer: Many tokens can be sold at once
questions.explain: When a lot of supply unlocks, selling pressure can grow.

questions.question: Liquidity is locked for a long time. What does that help prevent?
options: The team pulling the trading money out (a rug)
questions.answer: The team pulling the trading money out (a rug)
questions.explain: Locked liquidity cannot be removed by the team, but it does not make the token safe.

questions.question: A fair-looking split means the token is...
options: Not obviously rigged, but still risky
Safe to put all your money in
questions.answer: Not obviously rigged, but still risky
questions.explain: A good split removes one risk, not all of them.
